# Soft Pull Solutions

> > Soft Pull Solutions provides FCRA-compliant credit reporting APIs and soft pull credit solutions for mortgage lenders, bankruptcy attorneys, and tenant screening professionals.

Soft Pull Solutions LLC specializes in credit check web integration tools and APIs that support mortgage lending workflows including Fannie Mae Desktop Underwriter integration, FHA compliance, prequalification services, and comprehensive tenant screening. The platform offers both soft and hard pull credit reports from TransUnion, UCC reports, business credit reports, income verification, and background check services designed for loan origination and compliance management.
